environment.description: Same application deployed in a hardened container orchestrated via systemd-nspawn with a pivot_root into /srv/app (contains only node_modules, app.js, and package.json). The process runs under a custom seccomp-bpf profile that restricts syscalls to read/write/open/close/fstat/mmap/mprotect/munmap/brk/ioctl/socket/connect/sendto/recvfrom/epoll_create/epoll_ctl/epoll_wait/futex/clock_gettime/exit_group. The container's /proc is mounted read-only with hidepid=2. Network ingress is mediated by a userspace TCP proxy (envoy sidecar) configured with a Lua filter that performs response body inspection: any outbound HTML response where the response body contains a substring that exactly matches a raw query parameter value AND that value contains characters from the set [<>"'`(){}] triggers connection reset (TCP RST). The Envoy filter operates on the finalized response buffer before transmission to the client. Additionally, the container has no /tmp or writable directories beyond /srv/app/logs (append-only via chattr +a).

config.network_proxy: envoy 1.28 sidecar with lua response filter
config.envoy_lua_filter: response body reflection detection for chars [<>"'`(){}]
